style: Calm, premium, exact-brand static-frame logo assembly with one continuous route draw and a restrained destination-pin settle.
font: none; preserve the baked Beacon wordmark

blueprint.adaptation: The ring and wordmark are present from frame zero; the route assembles inside the ring, the destination pin settles, and the completed lockup holds without an exit.

shot_brief: The complete outer ring and Beacon wordmark are already centered on a transparent stage. After a 0.35-second landing hold, the route grows in one uninterrupted lower-left-to-destination stroke with gentle acceleration and a long deceleration. The pin becomes spatially revealed at the route endpoint and settles monotonically with critically damped motion—never fading or overshooting. At 2.30 seconds every animated channel stops and the exact finished lockup remains unchanged through 3.20 seconds.

shots.action: Show the complete base ring and baked Beacon wordmark at their final position. No animated property changes.
Reveal the route continuously from the lower-left opening to the destination while the pin reveal and settle overlap the route's final approach.
Hold the exact completed lockup dead static on transparency; no exit or ambient motion.

layers.role: Exact road pixels revealed by a single SVG path mask

motion.constraints: One continuous draw only; never restart, reverse, pulse, or redraw.

layers.role: Exact destination pin and endpoint detail

settle.constraints: Monotonic critically damped approximation; no bounce, overshoot, opacity animation, rotation, or post-settle drift.
